import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int T = 1; // As per original code, T is fixed to 1
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            solve(scanner);
        }
        scanner.close();
    }

    static void solve(Scanner scanner) {
        int total_points = scanner.nextInt();
        int multiplier = scanner.nextInt();

        int[] sequence = new int[total_points];
        for (int i = 0; i < total_points; i++) {
            sequence[i] = (multiplier * i) % total_points;
        }

        if (multiplier == 0) {
            System.out.println(powMod(total_points, total_points - 1, MOD));
            return;
        }

        boolean[] visited_nodes = new boolean[total_points];
        int[] cycle_size_count = new int[total_points + 1]; // size up to total_points
        long answer = 1;

        for (int node = 0; node < total_points; node++) {
            if (visited_nodes[node]) continue;
            int count = 0;
            int current_node = node;
            while (!visited_nodes[current_node]) {
                visited_nodes[current_node] = true;
                current_node = sequence[current_node];
                count++;
            }
            cycle_size_count[count]++;
        }

        for (int size = 1; size < total_points; size++) {
            if (cycle_size_count[size] != 0) {
                long total = size * cycle_size_count[size];
                if (size > 1) {
                    total += cycle_size_count[1];
                }
                answer = (answer * powMod(total, cycle_size_count[size], MOD)) % MOD;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(answer);
    }

    static long powMod(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        long power = base % mod;
        long exponent = exp;
        while (exponent > 0) {
            if ((exponent & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * power) % mod;
            }
            power = (power * power) % mod;
            exponent >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
